conventions.convention: M is the positive-meridian eigenvalue and L the preferred-longitude eigenvalue; choosing the other peripheral eigenline simultaneously inverts both.
The ordinary A-polynomial is primitive, square-free and determined up to ±M^aL^b; only one-dimensional maximal components of the eigenvalue-image closure contribute.

The enhanced polynomial uses irreducible-character contributions. The ordinary polynomial is lcm(enhanced polynomial,L−1), rather than necessarily their product; irreducible characters may themselves contribute L−1.
A primitive boundary class aλ+bμ has unoriented boundary slope b/a, with a=0 giving infinity. Strictness requires a realizing surface that is not a fiber of any exterior fibration over the circle.
Adjoint coefficients have left action g·v=ρ(g)vρ(g)⁻¹, whereas forward intrinsic transport in the first-loop-first convention is conjugation by ρ(g)⁻¹.

The ordered peripheral homology basis is (v⊗λ,v⊗μ); a kernel generator with coordinates (a,b) has BFR slope −b/a. Rational extension is projective-valued and does not assign actual homology values at every exceptional character.
Affine branches over singular points remain in the normalized affine open; only points outside that open are ideal points.
SL2(C)-abelian surgery quantifies over every representation, including reducible nonabelian representations; infinitely many surgeries means infinitely many distinct rational slopes.
Thinness means containment of the enhanced Newton polygon in an affine line, including the one-point polygon of the unit polynomial and the unknot.

load_bearing.statement: Assume full AC. For any finite r≥0, every polynomial invariant of r complex 2×2 matrices under simultaneous SL2 conjugation is a polynomial in word traces. Every invariant regular function on a closed reduced invariant algebraic subset is likewise a polynomial in restricted word traces.

Assume full AC. For a finitely presented group and a nonempty irreducible closed character subset containing an irreducible character, an absolutely irreducible generic representation exists over an extension of degree at most two of its function field, spreads over a principal open, and specializes to irreducible representatives of every character there.

Assume full AC. For the stated path-connected, locally path-connected, semilocally simply connected space with a specified finite presentation of its fundamental group, the presentation map induces an isomorphism on first homology with every stated local coefficient module and identifies the explicit ordered peripheral word cycles with the actual torus inclusion classes.

For the finite matrices over a domain with CB=CU=0 and rank(B|U)=rank(B)+1 over its fraction field, one nonzero localization gives explicit free homology bases and a rank-one peripheral kernel direct summand, compatible with every specialization to a field.

Assume full AC. Radical elimination of the finite representation, trace and eigenline incidence equations, followed by selection of precisely the one-dimensional irreducible components, yields the Laurent ideal defining the ordinary A-polynomial curve.
Assume full AC and let K⊂S³ be a nontrivial knot. Every finite rational or infinite slope of an edge of the enhanced A-polynomial Newton polygon is a strict boundary slope of K.
Assume full AC and let K⊂S³ be a smooth knot. Its enhanced A-polynomial is thin if and only if K is a torus knot, including the unknot.

Assume full AC. In the specified figure-eight presentation and trace coordinates, the unique component containing irreducible characters has irreducible equation 2x²+y²−x²y−y−1=0, nonconstant x, and preferred-longitude trace x⁴−5x²+2.

concerns.concern: The Definition says: “A surface S⊂E_K is properly embedded if S∩∂E_K=∂S and its interior lies in the interior of E_K.” Neither compactness nor properness of the inclusion is required. Under this explicit criterion, for any essential peripheral curve c of a nontrivial knot, the half-open collar annulus c×[0,ε) qualifies. Boundary incompressibility of the exterior makes this annulus π1-injective and hence incompressible; every compact embedded arc with endpoints on its sole boundary circle cuts off a disk, so it is also boundary-incompressible. It realizes any chosen peripheral slope and is not a compact fiber. Thus the written definition makes every slope a strict boundary slope. The standard compact/proper surface requirement must be recovered explicitly; this also affects the two-slope question and the longitudinal-surface consumer.

Facts F4 and Proof 3.1 use “relative finite simplicial approximation” to obtain a homotopy fixed on the aligned boundary. The cited thm-finite-simplicial-approximation-for-maps-of-pairs explicitly states “No pointwise fixing of a positive-dimensional restriction is asserted.” Retaining a product collar suggests the standard short repair, but the relative approximation on the remaining piece, with that collar fixed, is asserted rather than derived from the cited proposition.

The negative-crossing TikZ code draws the under-strand as “(1,3)--(1.58,2.58) (1.42,2.42)--(2,2)” and the over-strand as “(2,3)--(1,2)”. Both under-strand endpoints lie on the over-strand y=x+1, producing two contacts instead of a crossing with a gap. The fourth crossing repeats the same error after vertical translation. The intended descending diagonal has gap endpoints (1.42,2.58) and (1.58,2.42). The algebraic proof is independent of this defective drawing.

The Sivek–Zentner reference in both source metadata and Definition references points to https://arxiv.org/pdf/2103.12651v2. The [arXiv record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.12651) is a nuclear-experiment paper about Compton scattering. The intended [SU(2)-cyclic surgeries and the pillowcase](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.01957) is arXiv:1710.01957.

Source metadata names “François Florens” as coauthor of A slope invariant and the A-polynomial of knots. The [primary paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2103.14151) names Vincent Florens. The same literal metadata error occurs in lem-sl2-representation-variety-is-affine, def-adjoint-twisted-homology-and-culler-shalen-data, lem-sl2-trace-functions-are-regular-and-invariant, def-character-variety-logarithmic-slope-invariant, lem-figure-eight-character-and-longitude-traces, lem-adjoint-twisted-slope-is-rational-on-a-character-component, thm-a-polynomial-boundary-restriction-and-surgery-detector, thm-adjoint-logarithmic-gauss-slope-and-ideal-point, cex-knot-kt-20-boundary-case, and ex-knot-kt-20-worked-cases.

seams_checked.note: Positive based meridians, compatible access paths and the actual figure-eight crossing relations match the presentation and longitude consumers.
Chosen compact exteriors, positive normal-disk meridians and degree-one null-homologous longitudes are preserved. Full AC discharges the supplier's countable-choice hypotheses.

The Fox supplier is used with its row/right-action and presentation-complex scope. The owned degree-one comparison separately establishes the actual exterior peripheral map and explicitly handles the inverse intrinsic-transport convention.
Signed winding, zero framing and essential-torus hypotheses are retained. The consumers distinguish atoroidality from hyperbolicity and separately identify the metric input.
The consumers use all-but-finitely-many primitive fillings and distinguish ordinary trace-squared coordinates from augmented eigenvalue logarithms; closed-filling SL2 lifts are supplied separately.

The current instanton interfaces retain full AC. Stronger averse-knot, L-space and Alexander-coefficient inputs are explicitly imported from named primary results rather than inferred from the local ASD complex.

The downstream page and its three items were opened. Its remark declares the ordinary and enhanced A-polynomial definitions as context but makes no stronger A-polynomial inference or use of an open question as a premise.
